name: Aimeric Piriou
source:
Race: Fairy

Doctor Aimeric's herbal remedies are said to be like no other, though it seems most people seek him out for reasons other than illness... His affection, however, is hard to come by as it is primarily reserved for his young daughter, Bryn.
